cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
命运巫师
3 6" 3+ 15
天命庇护 1AP
灵能。选择对这名特工可见的一名己方次元密会
特工。直到这名特工下一次激活开始，这名特
工残废或这个行动被一名己方特工再次执行（以
先达成的条件为准），每当一名特工对那名被选
择中的特工执行射击时，您便可以重掷任意己方
防御骰子。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行
动。
蹂躏命运 1AP
灵能。选择位于这名特工 9" 内且可见的一名敌
方特工。直到这名特工下一次激活开始，这名特
工残废或这个行动被一名己方特工再次执行（以
先达成的条件为准），每当被选择的那名敌方特
工执行射击、近战或反击时，您的对手必须为它
掷骰结果为 6 的攻击骰子进行重掷，并在确定
标识的控制时将被选中敌方特工的 APL 属性视
为降低 1 点。请注意这不是对其 APL 属性的修
正，所以任何执行行动前产生的修正都会与本效
果相累加。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SORCERER OF DESTINY
3 6" 3+ 15
PROTECTED BY FATE 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one friendly WARPCOVEN operative
visible to this operative. Until the start of this operative’s
next activation, until it’s incapacitated or until this action is
performed again by a friendly operative (whichever comes
first), whenever an operative is shooting that selected
operative, you can re-roll any of your defence dice.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.
RAVAGE DESTINY 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one enemy operative visible to and
within 9" of this operative. Until the start of this operative’s
next activation, until it's incapacitated or until this action is
performed again by a friendly operative (whichever comes
first), whenever that enemy operative is shooting, fighting
or retaliating, your opponent must re-roll their attack dice
results of 6, and whenever determining control of a marker,
treat that enemy operative’s APL stat as 1 lower. Note this
isn't a change to its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative
with this.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
时间巫师
3 6" 3+ 15
时空波动 1AP
灵能。选择位于这名特工 6" 内且可见的一名己方次元密会特工，并将己方时空波涌标识放置在那名特工
的控制范围内。
在那名特工下一次激活结束时，若它没有残废且完全位于己方时空波涌标识 6" 内，便将那名特工从杀戮
区移除并重新放置在可以放置的位置；在重新放置时，它必须在其控制范围内拥有己方时空波涌标识（或
尽可能靠近），并随后将己方时空波涌标识从杀戮区移除。如果那名特工没有完全位于己方时空波涌标识
6" 内，则将那个标识移除。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内或者己方时空波涌标识位于杀戮区时执行此行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SORCERER OF TEMPYRION
3 6" 3+ 15
RECONSTITUTION RITUAL 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one friendly WARPCOVEN operative
visible to and within 6" of this operative. That operative
regains up to 2D3 lost wounds.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative, or if a friendly operative has
already performed this action during this turning point.
TEMPORAL FLUX 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one friendly WARPCOVEN operative
visible to and within 6" of this operative and place your
Temporal Flux marker within that operative’s control range.
At the end of that operative’s next activation, if it hasn’t been
incapacitated and is still wholly within 6" of your Temporal
Flux marker, remove that operative from the killzone and set
it back up in a location it can be placed; when it's set back
up, it must have your Temporal Flux marker within its control
range (or as close as possible). Then remove your Temporal
Flux marker from the killzone. If that operative isn't wholly
within 6" of your Temporal Flux marker (including if it’s
incapacitated), remove that marker from the killzone.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative, or if your Temporal Flux marker
is currently in the killzone.

cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SORCERER OF WARPFIRE
3 6" 3+ 15
*Mindburn: In the Resolve Attack Dice step, if you inflict damage
with any critical successes, the operative this weapon is being
used against gains one of your Mindburn tokens (if it doesn't
already have one) until the end of its next activation, until it’s
incapacitated or until a friendly operative uses this weapon again
(whichever comes first). Whenever an operative has one of your
Mindburn tokens, worsen the Hit stat of its weapons by 1 (this
isn’t cumulative with being injured).
ALIGHT 1AP
PSYCHIC. Select one enemy operative visible to this
operative. Until the start of this operative’s next activation,
until it's incapacitated or until this action is performed
again by a friendly operative (whichever comes first), that
enemy operative gains one of your Alight tokens (if it doesn’t
already have one). Whenever a friendly WARPCOVEN
operative is shooting against, fighting against or retaliating
against an enemy operative that has one of your Alight
tokens, that friendly operative’s weapons have the Ceaseless
weapon rule.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

• 红字战士徽记持有者
• 红字战士战士
• 奸角兽勇士3，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 巨斧
○ 巨剑
• 奸角兽号手3
• 奸角兽徽记持有者3
• 奸角兽战士3 ，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 奸角兽双刃
○ 奸角兽之刃和盾牌
○ 自动手枪；链锯剑
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPE: RECON, SECURITY
OPERATIVES
↘ 5 WARPCOVEN operatives selected from the
following list:
• SORCERER OF DESTINY1
• SORCERER OF TEMPYRION1
• SORCERER OF WARPFIRE1
• RUBRIC MARINE GUNNER with one of the
following options:
○ Warpflamer; fists
○ Soulreaper cannon2; fists
• RUBRIC MARINE ICON BEARER
• RUBRIC MARINE WARRIOR
• TZAANGOR CHAMPION3 with one of the
following options:
○ Greataxe
○ Greatblade
• TZAANGOR HORN BEARER3
• TZAANGOR ICON BEARER3
• TZAANGOR WARRIOR3 with one of the
following options:
○ Tzaangor blades
○ Tzaangor blade & shield
○ Autopistol; chainsword
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.image: 10-02-小队选择-次元密会杀戮小队-2.png
cards.text:
1 装备有灵能杖，数据卡上的灵能武器以及以下
一种选项：
• 地狱火爆矢手枪
• 普罗斯佩罗弯刀
• 亚空间炽焰手枪2
2 您的杀戮小队至多只能包含一把亚空间炽焰手
枪和一门灵魂收割者炮。
3 这些特工各自被视为半个选项，因此您可以选
择两名这样的特工，视为一个特工选项。
您必须选择至少一名己方巫师特工，除了战士特
工，每一种特工在您的杀戮小队中只能被包含
一次。
cards.text_en:
You must select at least one friendly SORCERER
operative. Other than WARRIOR operatives, your
kill team can only include each operative on this
list once.
1 With force stave, PSYCHIC weapons on their
datacard and one of the following options:
• Inferno bolt pistol
• Prosperine khopesh
• Warpflame pistol2
2 Your kill team can only include up to
one warpflame pistol and up to one
soulreaper cannon.
3 These operatives count as half a selection each,
meaning you can select both of them and it’s
treated as one selection in total.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营规则
奸奇恩惠
作为虔诚的奸奇信徒，次元密会巫师从其信奉
的神明处获得了大量恩惠——从有益变异，恶
魔知识到法术奥秘应有尽有。
当您为一场战斗选择了巫师特工，便必须为它选
择一个战斗中使用的奸奇恩惠（见下文）。每个
奸奇恩惠在一场战斗中不能被选择超过一次。
虚化视觉
千子巫师们能感知到生灵们散发出的至高天
能量。
这名特工的远程武器获得“集中”武器规则。当
这名特工执行射击时，敌方特工无法被遮挡。
时间行者
鲜少有什么恩惠能比操纵时间本身更为强大
了。
这名特工的移动属性增加 1"。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION RULE
BOONS OF TZEENTCH
Warpcoven Sorcerers are dedicated followers of Tzeentch,
and have earned many great boons from their patron
deity, from beneficial mutations to diabolical knowledge.
Whenever you select a SORCERER operative for
the battle, you must select a BOON OF TZEENTCH
(below) for it to have for the battle. You cannot
select each BOON OF TZEENTCH more than once
per battle.
Incorporeal Sight
The empyric energies given off by living creatures can be
sensed by the Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons.
This operative’s ranged weapons have the
Saturate weapon rule. Whenever this operative is
shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured.
Time-Walk
There are few greater boons than mastery over time itself.
Add 1" to this operative’s Move stat.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
亚空间残响
在能够预知未来的情况下，掌握敌人的动向轻
而易举。
每场战斗限一次，当您使用这名特工反击时，可
以更改它的命令，并且可以在那次反击中额外执
行一个消耗 1 AP 的行动，但两次行动必须为不
同的行动。
亚空间强化
在注入亚空间力量后，近身肉搏变得极为凶
猛。
这名特工近战武器的普通伤害属性增加 1 点。
变异肢体
尽管外观有些惊骇，但额外的肢体非常实用。
控制范围内有一名敌方特工不会阻止这名特工
执行拾取标识或任务行动。每次激活限一次，
这名特工可以在执行拾取标识或任务行动时减
少 1 AP。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
Echoes from the Warp
An ability to predict the future allows for stronger
responses to enemy movement.
Once per battle, when you counteract with
this operative, you can change its order, and it
can perform an additional 1AP action for free
during that counteraction, but both actions must
be different.
Warp Swell
An influx of warp power grants impetus to melee strikes.
Add 1 to the Normal Dmg stat of this operative’s
melee weapons.
Mutant Appendage
Horrific though they may appear, additional limbs are
useful indeed.
Having an enemy operative within this operative’s
control range doesn’t prevent it from performing
the Pick Up Marker or mission actions. Once per
activation, this operative can perform the Pick
Up Marker, Place Marker or a mission action for
1 less AP.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
亚空间飞行
在获得飞行之力后，巫师变得极为敏捷。
每个转折点限一次，当这名特工在它的激活中执
行冲锋或转移行动时，它可以飞行。若此，不要
移动它。作为替代，将它从杀戮区移除并将其重
新放置在完全位于其原本位置一定范围内（相当
于其移动属性的距离）的位置（只测量水平距
离）。在使用近距离战斗规则的杀戮区时（例如
杀戮区：墓穴世界），测量不能穿过墙壁地形，
并且那名特工不能被放置在访问点的另一侧（换
言之，它不能飞行穿过打开的舱门过道）。请注
意，这不会在执行冲锋行动中获得额外距离，且
必须被放置在它可以被放置的位置。此外，除非
它执行的是冲锋行动，否则无法被放置在一名敌
方特工的控制范围内。
扭曲命运
还有什么恩惠能比得上凭意志便能扭曲他人
命运？
这名特工的灵能远程武器获得“关键穿刺 1”武
器规则。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
Immaterial Flight
The power of flight renders the recipient highly elusive.
Once per turning point, when this operative is
performing the Charge or Reposition action
during its activation, it can FLY. If it does, don’t
move it. Instead, remove it from the killzone and
set it back up wholly within a distance equal to
its Move stat horizontally of its original location.
In a killzone that uses the close quarters rules
(e.g. Killzone: Tomb World), this distance cannot
be measured over or through Wall terrain, and
that operative cannot be set up on the other side
of an access point (in other words, it cannot FLY
through an open hatchway). Note that it gains
no additional distance when performing the
Charge action. It must be set up in a location it
can be placed, and unless it’s the Charge action,
it cannot be set up within control range of an
enemy operative.
Twist of Fate
What greater boon than the ability to bend fate to one’s
own will.
This operative’s PSYCHIC ranged weapons have
the Piercing Crits 1 weapon rule.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
星爆术
在痛饮备受赐福的至高天能量后，巫师获得了
毫无拘束的毁灭能量。
选择这名特工的一个灵能远程武器。那个武器获
得“毁灭 1”武器规则。若您选择了毁灭之矢，
则它会获得“2" 毁灭 2”武器规则替代“毁灭
2”武器规则。如果您选择了烈焰风暴或者焚却
理智(亚空间炽焰巫师)，那么每当那名特工执行
射击行动时，选择“追踪轻型”或者“毁灭 1”
武器规则，直到那次行动结束前，那件武器拥有
被选择的技能（不能同时选择这两个武器技能)。
非物质界专家
禁忌奥术学识能提供极为可怕的灵能力量。
当这名特工的灵能行动有距离要求时，为其增
加 3" 距离。请注意，在时间巫师的时空波动行
动中，这个恩惠的效果指挥影响那个规则的第一
个效果。
cards.text_en:
Astral Bombardment
The truly blessed drink deeply of the Warp’s entropic
power, wielding its destructive energies with abandon.
Select one of this operative's PSYCHIC ranged
weapons. That weapon has the Devastating 1
weapon rule. If you select a doombolt, it has
the 2" Devastating 2 weapon rule instead of
Devastating 2. If you select firestorm or mindburn
(SORCERER OF WARPFIRE), whenever that
operative performs the Shoot action, select the
Seek Light or Devastating 1 weapon rule for that
weapon to have until the end of the action (it
cannot have both).
Master of the Immaterium
The gift of forbidden arcane knowledge grants the
recipient terrible psychic power.
Add 3" to the distance requirements of this
operative’s PSYCHIC actions that have a distance
requirement. Note that for the SORCERER OF
TEMPYRION’s Temporal Flux action, this boon
only affects the distance in the first effect of
that rule.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营规则
阿斯塔特
这些经受了基因强化的超人们的存在意义只有
一个：战争。
在每一名己方次元密会阿斯塔特叛军特工的激
活期间，特工可以执行两次近战行动或者两次射
击行动。如果两次行动都使用了灵魂收割者炮或
亚空间火焰喷射器进行攻击，那么第二次行动必
须消耗额外 1AP。此外，在每次激活中您不能选
择同一个灵能远程武器超过一次。
无论其拥有的命令，每一名己方次元密会阿斯
塔特叛军特工都可以进行反应。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION RULE
ASTARTES
These genetically modified superhumans are made for
one purpose: war.
During each friendly WARPCOVEN HERETIC
ASTARTES operative’s activation, it can perform
either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If
it’s two Shoot actions and a soulreaper cannon or
a warpflamer is selected for both, 1 additional AP
must be spent for the second action. You cannot
select the same PSYCHIC ranged weapon more
than once per activation.
Each friendly WARPCOVEN HERETIC ASTARTES
operative can counteract regardless of its order.

cards.text:
次元密会
战略计谋
以太守护
千子巫师们用法术保护着他的战士们，一道至
高天之力形成的屏障保护着他们。
当一名特工向一名己方次元密会特工射击时，
拥有“穿刺 1”武器规则的武器将变为拥有“关
键穿刺 1”规则。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
STRATEGY PLOY
AETHERIAL WARDING
The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons ward their
warriors with spells, shielding them with a barrier of
empyric force.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
WARPCOVEN operative, weapons with the
Piercing 1 weapon rule have the Piercing Crits 1
weapon rule instead.

cards.image: 20-02-战略计谋-彼之命运，我之凶器.png
cards.text:
次元密会
战略计谋
彼之命运，我之凶器
通过对命运丝线的操弄，巫师能够亲自手刃敌
人，或确保自己的战士进行致命打击。
掷两枚 D6 并留置它们（将它们放在一边）。在
该转折点的交战阶段中，每当一名特工执行射
击，近战或反击时，在您或您的对手掷攻击骰子
后，进行重掷前，您可以在那个流程中将其中一
枚 D6 替换为您留置的一枚骰子（您或您对手的
骰子都可以被替换）；那枚被替代的 D6 无法被
修正和重掷或者在不是对应结果的情况下被作为
一次成功进行保留，并且在流程结束后被舍弃。
之后，如果两枚留置骰子的数值总和小于 9，便
弃置那个另一枚骰子。在每个流程中您不能使用
留置骰子超过一次。在转折点结束时，弃置任何
剩余的留置骰子。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
STRATEGY PLOY
FATE ITSELF IS MY WEAPON
By manipulating the skeins of fate, a Sorcerer may stay
the blade of a foe, or ensure their own warriors land a
killing strike.
Roll two D6 and reserve them (put them to one
side). In the Firefight phase of this turning point,
whenever an operative is shooting, fighting
or retaliating, after you or your opponent roll
their attack dice, but before re-rolls, you can
use one of your reserved dice to replace one of
the D6 rolled for that sequence (yours or your
opponent's); that replacement dice cannot be
re-rolled or retained as a success if it’s not, and
is discarded at the end of that sequence. Then,
if the combined result of both reserved dice was
less than 9, discard the other dice. You cannot
use more than one reserved dice per sequence.
Discard any remaining reserved dice at the end of
the turning point.

cards.text:
次元密会
战略计谋
巫师兄弟会
通过血脉和法术缔结密会，千子巫师们的灵能
潜力大大强化。
己方次元密会巫师特工的灵能武器获得“平
衡”武器规则，若那名特工 9" 内有另一名己方
次元密会巫师特工，则会获得“无休”武器规
则作为替代。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
STRATEGY PLOY
BROTHERHOOD OF SORCERERS
By forming covens bound by blood and magick, the
Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons greatly increase the
potency of their psychic powers.
Friendly WARPCOVEN SORCERER operatives’
PSYCHIC weapons have the Balanced weapon
rule, or Ceaseless instead if another friendly
WARPCOVEN SORCERER operative is within 9"
of that operative.

cards.text:
次元密会
战略计谋
野蛮兽群
野兽般的奸角兽们展现出了堪比其狂野的奸
诈，而在强大巫师现身时这一点更为突出。
己方次元密会奸角兽特工的近战武器获得“精
准 1”武器规则。此外，当一名己方次元密会
奸角兽特工被一名己方次元密会特工协助，或
在位于一名己方次元密会巫师特工 6" 内且可见
的情况下执行近战，那名己方次元密会奸角兽
特工的近战武器还会获得“严重”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
STRATEGY PLOY
SAVAGE HERD
Though bestial of form, the Tzaangor possess great
cunning to match their savagery, particularly when
fighting in the presence of a powerful Sorcerer.
Friendly WARPCOVEN TZAANGOR operatives’
melee weapons have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
Whenever a friendly WARPCOVEN TZAANGOR
operative is assisted by a friendly WARPCOVEN
operative, or is fighting while visible to and within
6" of a friendly WARPCOVEN SORCERER
operative, that friendly WARPCOVEN
TZAANGOR operative's melee weapons also have
the Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
次元密会
交战计谋
皆为尘土
作为不再由血肉塑造的战士，红字战士们展现
出超自然的坚韧。
当一枚攻击骰子对一名己方次元密会红字战士
特工造成普通伤害时使用本交战计谋。那枚攻击
骰子造成 1 点伤害作为替代。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ALL IS DUST
No longer warriors of flesh and blood, the Rubricae are
possessed of an unnatural resilience.
Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts
Normal Dmg on a friendly WARPCOVEN RUBRIC
MARINE operative. That attack dice inflicts 1
damage instead.

cards.text:
次元密会
交战计谋
无常计划
在遭遇战中，巫师们如同梭影般施展着未知的
阴谋，导致那些洞察力极为敏锐的敌人都无法
看穿其目的与野心。
在一名己方次元密会巫师特工激活结束时使用
本交战计谋。那名己方特工可以立即执行一次无
消耗的冲刺行动（即便执行了会阻止它执行冲刺
行动的行动也不受影响），或者您可以为此改变
它的命令作为替代。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CAPRICIOUS PLAN
Sorcerers dart from skirmish to firefight in the
furtherance of their unknowable schemes, their
goals and ambitions indecipherable to even the most
insightful of foes.
Use this firefight ploy at the end of a friendly
WARPCOVEN SORCERER operative’s activation.
That friendly operative can immediately perform
a free Dash action (even if it’s performed an
action that prevents it from performing the Dash
action), or you can change its order instead.

cards.text:
次元密会
交战计谋
灵能阴谋团
通过连结力量，密会的巫师们可以共享学识，
使灵能更为致命。
在一名己方次元密会巫师特工激活时使用本交
战计谋。选择位于那名特工 9" 内且可见的另一
名己方次元密会巫师特工，随后那个第一名己
方特工可以选择另一名己方特工的灵能独特行动
或灵能远程武器在它的激活结束前使用。您不能
选择一件在转折点中被另一名己方特工使用过的
灵能远程武器，并且那另一名己方特工不能在转
折点中使用被选择的武器。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PSYCHIC CABAL
Pooling their power, a coven of Sorcerers may share
their learnings, rendering their psychic powers even
more deadly.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
WARPCOVEN SORCERER operative is activated.
Select one other friendly WARPCOVEN
SORCERER operative visible to and within 9"
of that operative, then select one of that other
friendly operative's PSYCHIC unique actions or
PSYCHIC ranged weapons for that first friendly
operative to have until the end of its activation.
You cannot select a PSYCHIC ranged weapon that
has been used by that other friendly operative
during this turning point, and that other friendly
operative cannot use the selected weapon during
this turning point.

cards.text:
次元密会
交战计谋
变种兽群
成群的奸角兽合作无间，能在协同攻击中展现
出奇妙的精准。
在一名己方次元密会奸角兽特工激活时使用
本交战计谋。选择位于它 2" 内、可见且就绪的
另一名己方次元密会奸角兽特工并同时激活它
们。您需要按照任意顺序一个行动接着一个行动
完成它们的激活。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
MUTANT HERD
Tzaangor herds share an instinctive understanding,
coordinating their attacks with eerie precision.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
WARPCOVEN TZAANGOR operative is activated.
Select one other ready friendly WARPCOVEN
TZAANGOR operative visible to and within 2" of
it to activate at the same time. Complete their
activations action by action in any order.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营装备
附魔弹药
在咒术和黑魔法的加持下，自动手枪和爆失枪
弹药的致命性被大大加强了。
己方特工的地狱火爆矢枪、地狱火爆矢手枪和自
动手枪获得“毁灭 1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ENSORCELLED ROUNDS
The placing of hexes and casting of dark magicks
enhance the lethality of autopistol and bolt rounds.
Friendly WARPCOVEN operatives’ inferno
boltguns, inferno bolt pistols and autopistols have
the Devastating 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营装备
魔啮武器
红字战士的的武器已经在非物质界被扭曲了数
千年之久。于枪口处突出的锋利恶魔之口作为
近战武器极为有效。
为己方次元密会红字战士特工的近战武器的攻
击属性增加 1 点。每当一名己方次元密会红字
战士特工进行反击时，它的近战武器获得“精准
1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DAEMONMAW WEAPONS
The weapons of the Rubricae have been warped by
millennia spent immersed in the immaterium. Daemonic
maws erupt around gun muzzles, their razor beaks
serving as effective melee weapons.
Add 1 to the Atk stat of friendly WARPCOVEN
RUBRIC MARINE operatives’ melee weapons.
Whenever a friendly WARPCOVEN RUBRIC
MARINE operative is retaliating, its melee
weapons have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营装备
奥术长袍
巫师披风上强大的防御法术能够通过偏转攻击
接下极为强大的打击。
每个转折点限一次，每当一名己方次元密会巫
师特工因为一枚攻击骰子而受到暴击伤害时，您
可以使用本规则。若使用，将那枚攻击骰子替换
为普通伤害。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ARCANE ROBES
Powerful defensive wards in the Sorcerer’s cloaks allow
them to deflect attacks, absorbing the force of the most
powerful strikes.
Once per turning point, whenever an attack
dice would inflict Critical Dmg on a friendly
WARPCOVEN SORCERER operative, you can use
this rule. If you do, that attack dice inflicts Normal
Dmg instead.

cards.text:
次元密会
阵营装备
巫术卷轴
来自普罗斯佩罗宝库中罕见而危险的卷轴能使
巫师们向奸奇祈求更强大的力量。
每场战斗限制一次，每当己方次元密会巫师特
工激活或反应时，您可以选择让其拥有一个不同
的奸奇恩惠，持续至战斗结束（特工失去任何原
先拥有的恩惠)。特工不能选择任何其他己方战士
已经拥有的奸奇恩惠。
cards.text_en:
WARPCOVEN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SORCEROUS SCROLLS
Rare and dangerous scrolls from the vaults of Prospero
allow the Sorcerers to beseech Tzeentch for even
greater power.
Once per battle, when a friendly WARPCOVEN
SORCERER operative is activated or counteracts,
you can select a different BOON OF TZEENTCH for
it to have until the end of the battle (it loses any it
previously had). It cannot be the same BOON OF
TZEENTCH any other friendly operative has. Note
that if you use this rule when a friendly operative
counteracts and you select Echoes from the
Warp, it can be used immediately to change the
operative’s order and perform a free action during
that counteraction.
